ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area estimated at approximately 85-90% with localized high-intensity (white) mottling comprising 10-15% of the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white patches are concentrated along the trailing edges and the periphery of the median notch. Contiguous white banding is visible on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by stochastic peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes varying between 2 and 8 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in slightly tapered apexes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense distribution of circular and ring-shaped high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacle attachment scars) scattered across the dark regions of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple horizontal and diagonal high-intensity linear marks (rake marks) of varying lengths (10-50 pixels) disrupting the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the ventral surface and significant irregular jaggedness along the trailing edge consistent with long-term environmental interaction.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, near-vertical high-intensity white bar located on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe (viewer perspective).
